summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules, reporting a share repurchase activity. On May 7, 2026, the company repurchased 777,321 ordinary shares on the Nasdaq Stock Market at USD 2.4908 per share, representing approximately 0.0819% of existing issued shares before the event, adding 777,321 shares to treasury. The total issued shares remained unchanged at 972,508,041, with treasury shares increasing to 23,793,493. Management confirmed board authorization and compliance with listing rules. This is a routine open-market buyback, not a tender offer or structural capital return program. Watch for continued buyback cadence and potential impact on share count and liquidity.
